//: Deny rules hold in every permission mode, including bypass. They are belt-and-braces on top of hooks/atlas-guard.mjs — the guard is the enforcement, these are the second layer.
///: No ATLAS_GUARD_FAIL_OPEN here, deliberately: the guard fails CLOSED by default, and that default should ship silent. Setting it to 1 is a one-time, visible, opt-in decision an operator makes themselves — not something a template sets on their behalf. (An earlier version of this file set the now-unread ATLAS_GUARD_FAIL_CLOSED=1, a dead reference left over from before the guard's fail-polarity was inverted.)
